ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Child Care Assistance Program
ideas.description: Investigate potential fraud in Minnesota's child care assistance program and track the flow of federal funds
questions: How much federal funding has been allocated to Minnesota's child care assistance program?
What measures are in place to prevent fraud in the program?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant waste or fraud in a critical social program, and could lead to reforms and improvements in the program's administration.
